name: 3D Lanyard Badge
description: An interactive 3D lanyard badge for React and three.js: an event pass on a strap that you can grab, drag, throw and spin, with verlet rope physics and clearcoat lighting. Both faces are drawn from props, so it shows at once with nothing to load.

props.name: code
props.description: Badge number, printed on the front and used to draw the pattern on the back.

props.name: label
props.description: Small label at the top of the front.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent colour on the front (glow, disc, code). Hex.

props.name: cardColor
props.description: Front and edge colour; also the ink on the back.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height; the strap hangs from the top.
